title: Afterglow quenching in plasma-based dry reforming of methane: a detailed analysis of the post-plasma chemistry via kinetic modelling
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00676C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Joachim Slaets, Eduardo Morais, Annemie Bogaerts
Chemical kinetics modelling of the afterglow of a CO2–CH4 plasma reveals that cooling in excess CO2 alters the product distribution through the water gas shift reaction, while mixing of cold gas can improve the conversion by using the residual heat.
